title: 6G Extreme-MIMO (X-MIMO) 7 GHz Network
summary: 256-port massive MIMO base station operating in the 7 GHz upper mid-band for 6G; achieves 8-layer spatial multiplexin...
bodyHtml:
What This Is

256-port massive MIMO base station operating in the 7 GHz upper mid-band for 6G; achieves 8-layer spatial multiplexing and 3+ Gbps per user over 100 MHz. Demonstrated in Samsung field trials Seoul & Plano TX (2026). WRC-23 internationally allocated 7.125 GHz for IMT..

Working prototypes demonstrated. Engineering challenges remain before commercial deployment. Our research database tracks 29 independent sources on this technology.

WRC-23 internationally allocated 7.125 GHz band for IMT (6G). US government repurposing memo, EU and Korea active spectrum planning.

Seeded from Samsung arXiv 2603.21632v1, Mar 2026

Status

Attribute Value
Development Stage Prototype
Confidence Level Researching
Confidence Score +0.361
Estimated Reality 2028–2036
Timeline Confidence 65%
Monetizable By 2031 (est. confidence: 56%)
Horizon Near-Term (2028)
Independent Sources Tracked 29

Timeline Intelligence

Milestone Estimate Confidence
Technology Reality 2028–2036 65%
Commercially Monetizable 2031 56%

Moderate timing confidence (65%): roadmap exists but execution risk remains.

Prerequisites

This technology depends on or requires advances in:

  • 2nm Process Node (TSMC N2) ✓: requires

What This Enables

Advancement here directly benefits or unblocks:

  • AI Inference at Edge: enables
  • V2X Vehicle-to-Everything Comms: enables
  • AR Smart Glasses (Consumer / Daily): enables
  • High-Bandwidth Wireless BCI (1024ch): accelerates
  • AI-Autonomous Security Operations Centre: synergises with

Investment Exposure

No direct listed-stock exposure identified yet in our research database.
